<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-formal-spot-boundary kind=requirement -->
Map discovery distinguishes formal spots with stable spot_id from ordinary POIs; an ordinary place may recenter the map, find nearby formal spots, or create a separately reviewed proposal, but cannot enter Spot Night or synthesize spot_id.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-location-fallback kind=requirement -->
Map cold start shows the default trial region without forcing location permission; only an explicit nearby or one-shot position action requests location once, rejection preserves manual city/place selection and the trial-region fallback, and continuous location is never enabled by default.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-viewport-loading kind=requirement -->
The native map loads formal spots for the current viewport plus bounded buffer, debounces movement by 200–350 ms, cancels superseded requests, clusters at low zoom, and restores viewport, zoom, committed filters, selection and loaded points.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-finder-single-entry kind=requirement -->
The compact Search summary is the sole Map entry for query, all filters and the saved-place relation; panelOnly SourceLift turns the lifted 查找观星点 header itself into the only explicit expand/collapse control, with no sibling close or second title.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-finder-query-projection kind=requirement -->
Finder query and the exact committed filter set derive one formal-spot result projection; results have only collapsible Wanted and Other first-level partitions, city is only a heading, and history/fuzzy suggestions are a field-anchored overlay mutually exclusive with Filter.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-filter-schema kind=requirement -->
One FilterSchema and one committed state own exactly 18 flat terminal filters in the Source-defined 10+8 order: opening snapshots committed state, dirty edits remain draft-only, revert restores the snapshot, commit atomically replaces the committed set, and Finder dismissal discards uncommitted draft.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-filter-accessibility kind=requirement -->
Every Filter choice retains a 44px target, role/name/checked state, selected border and shared half-clipped rounded-star decorator so selection is not color-only; dirty revert/commit use distinct centered Tier-A SVG glyphs in named 44px targets.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-finder-scroll-and-layout kind=requirement -->
Finder results and Filter keep bounded owner scrolling with scrollbar chrome hidden but touch, wheel and keyboard reachability preserved; query/filter overlays do not move result or phone scroll geometry, including 320/375/430, large text and reduced motion.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-marker-callout-selection kind=requirement -->
Marker, Finder result, selected marker and compact callout share one selected formal spot; Finder selection closes to and recenters the same map callout, while only valid callout release, keyboard or accessibility activation enters Detail and drag-away/cancel never navigates.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-first-viewport-map kind=requirement -->
At normal text size the compact header, one Search row, remaining-height map and equal Map/My navigation fit the first 320x800, 375x900 and 430x932 viewport; the base map and formal markers are always present and permanent pan/zoom chrome is absent.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-analysis-overlay kind=requirement -->
The in-map 观测条件 bar opens mapCoupled SourceLift over the same physical map and controls at most one of NONE, LIGHT, TOTAL_CLOUD or OPPORTUNITY; base map and formal markers are not peer layers, and LIGHT stays static for its declared source period.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-selected-time-preview kind=requirement -->
Exactly one committed selectedAt owns Map and formal Spot Night time; Map scrub preview updates already-loaded feedback immediately, cancel restores the commit, valid release commits atomically, and the compact focus panel renders exactly one visible local date/time value without internal vertical scrolling.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-source-lift-lifecycle kind=requirement -->
One SourceLiftFocusLayer owns IDLE, LIFTING, FOCUSED, RESTORING and CANCELLED for panelOnly and mapCoupled, remains interruptible from the live presentation value, preserves focus/Back/Escape/scrim semantics and exposes a reduced-motion equivalent.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-source-lift-restore kind=requirement -->
During SourceLift restore the one live node remains overlay-owned and moves from its current geometry to one exact origin placeholder; the underlying phone/map flow never moves, the next frame atomically returns ownership, and no clone, remount, duplicate store, jump, flash, ghost or empty terminal frame is allowed.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-light-layer-provenance kind=requirement -->
The light-pollution layer is a trial-region estimate with legend, source, data date, precision/estimate disclosure and bounded geometry; it is never represented as precise measured Bortle truth.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-route-semantics kind=requirement -->
Distance, drive time, walking segment, last-road and parking guidance are separately typed; straight-line distance is never labelled as a route and route calculation occurs only on explicit demand.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-external-navigation kind=requirement -->
Go Here hands a formal target coordinate to an explicit supported external map choice, reports denial/failure, and retains copy/manual recovery without claiming in-Mini-Program turn-by-turn navigation.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-curated-population kind=requirement -->
Demo serves a complete curated population of 20–50 trial-region formal stargazing spots with stable IDs, provenance, visibility policy and deterministic eligible/excluded enumeration.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=map-discovery-empty-and-error kind=requirement -->
No-result, permission-denied, partial, stale and provider-error states preserve the static map, formal spots, favorite relation, query/filter context and lower-priority recovery states; one shared Notification owner arbitrates error before warning before info before success and never substitutes realistic fake values.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-spot-context kind=requirement -->
Spot Detail opens only with a valid formal spot_id and preserves that identity through its fixed header and the Overview, Guides and Site segments; Spot Night is one explicit spot/sky child route, never a fourth segment or global destination.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-segmented-loading kind=requirement -->
The first request loads header plus Overview; Guides and Site load on first entry with independent cache/error/retry, and changing date refreshes only dynamic Tonight/Spot Night data without unnecessarily refetching immutable facility or media evidence.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-media-provenance kind=requirement -->
Representative media appears first and records site/non-site status, photographer, license, source link, capture time/direction when reliable, sequence and captions; non-site media cannot prove site facts.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-tonight-decision kind=requirement -->
Tonight exposes recommendation, best window, principal favorable/adverse factors, suitable observing/photography type, confidence, freshness and a Night Sky action.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-hard-blockers kind=requirement -->
Thunderstorm, severe rain/wind, closure, road closure, explicit danger, illegal access, expired critical data or material field conflict are evaluated before scoring and cannot be averaged into a positive recommendation.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-route-facility-evidence kind=requirement -->
Route, parking, walking, access, toilet, platform, charging, camping, signal, openness, obstruction, light direction and safety facts carry source, verification status and freshness without substituting missing values with zero.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-favorite-rollback kind=requirement -->
Favorite is optimistic, rolls back visibly on failure, and the static favorite relation survives stale or unavailable dynamic summaries.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-guide-articles kind=requirement -->
Guide cards and articles expose author/source/type/publish/update/verification metadata; Demo publishes official content and sanitized structured blocks, never executable arbitrary HTML.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-site-safety kind=requirement -->
Site details include arrival, parking/stay, facilities, observing environment, directional obstruction, foreground and explicit night risks/closure/companionship/weather restrictions.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-quiet-header-actions kind=requirement -->
The identity header owns a visually borderless Favorite glyph beside the name in a 44px hit region, one quiet trailing 去这里 → action in the distance/route row, and one upper 查看此处夜空 child entry; facilities contain facts and never repeat a page action row.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-header-core-information kind=requirement -->
The identity header contains neither 地点资料可用 nor 今晚条件会变化 chips or synonyms; usable status, freshness, changing conditions and limitations stay in the owning Overview, source and facility evidence regions.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-detail-tab-motion kind=requirement -->
Overview, Guides and Site use one stable-geometry translating indicator and one committed accessible panel; each final retarget immediately removes the old panel from interaction/accessibility, cancels prior motion and runs one monotonic 160ms opacity enter, while reduced motion converges immediately or within 100ms.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-data-disclosure kind=requirement -->
Every dynamic or static conclusion exposes data kind, provider/authority, generated/observed time, applicable time, verification, freshness, confidence/completeness and user moderation state when applicable.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-detail-partial-recovery kind=requirement -->
Dynamic failure does not hide usable static place/media/guide content; INITIAL, LOADING, READY, EMPTY, PARTIAL, STALE, ERROR and PERMISSION_DENIED have explicit feedback and recovery.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-scoped-entry kind=requirement -->
Night Sky has no primary-tab or current-location entry and requires the formal Spot Detail spot_id plus local date, timezone, data revisions and algorithm/catalog versions.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-two-layer-information kind=requirement -->
The first layer answers suitability, time, key obstacle, moon impact, Milky Way direction, targets and capture mode; a second aligned layer exposes hourly professional weather, darkness, moon and celestial data.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-computed-targets kind=requirement -->
Recommended targets carry stable target ID, display name, type, window, direction/altitude, reason, source and confidence computed for the current spot/date; Orion, Jupiter, Venus, meteor shower and moon conjunction examples are fixtures only.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-versioned-sky-map kind=requirement -->
The Demo sky map uses versioned Canvas 2D direction ring, horizon, principal constellation lines, bright stars, planets, Moon, Milky Way center and recommended targets, not AR or a full deep-sky catalogue.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-time-scrubber kind=requirement -->
The local Spot Night scrubber, current time, opportunity, cloud, Moon, stability, sky map, professional matrix and target list share one selectedAt and one observation-night boundary, including cross-midnight behavior and explicit source/limitation disclosure.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-orientation-fallback kind=requirement -->
Compass orientation is optional presentation input with quality indication and manual calibration/fallback; sensor state cannot alter astronomical truth or hide essential actions.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-observation-mode kind=requirement -->
Spot Night consumes the one global closed near-black/warm-red observation presentation but exposes no mode-entry card or local store; only standalone My Settings may enter or exit it, and exit restores the exact prior Day/Night mode, route, spot, time and pending context without white placeholder, skeleton, media or system flash.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-offline-freshness kind=requirement -->
Observation mode pre-caches bounded key hours, shows last-update/offline status, uses stale data only within policy and never labels hard-expired data as a current recommendation.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-astronomy-inputs kind=requirement -->
Astronomy calculations use WGS84, elevation, IANA timezone, local observation date and versioned algorithms/catalogues, covering twilight, moon, moonless night, Milky Way and target altitude/azimuth windows.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-golden-validation kind=requirement -->
Astronomy code is checked against fixed location/date golden cases and an independent authoritative source, including cross-midnight, timezone, altitude, no-rise/set and extreme-latitude cases.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-reduced-motion kind=requirement -->
Reduced motion preserves state feedback using immediate or at-most-100 ms opacity changes, while ordinary gestures remain interruptible and retarget from live position.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=spot-night-night-recovery kind=requirement -->
Missing sensor, weak network, partial weather, unavailable optional events and drawing failure each retain understandable core results or an explicit data-insufficient state with retry/manual recovery.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-account-center-root kind=requirement -->
My is a conventional account-center root with a title-only header, one 44px Tier-A Settings gear, a concise profile summary and a small grouped list of normal-height rows; it has no subtitle, peer branch tabs, Favorites section, plan summary card, official sample article or commercial clutter.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-saved-place-owner kind=requirement -->
The saved-place relation remains owned by Finder Wanted and the one quiet Spot Detail favorite toggle; My must not duplicate the relation, render a Favorites branch or create a second Spot Detail projection.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-plan-child-route kind=requirement -->
A quiet My row opens one standalone Plan child route; Plan supports recoverable create, edit and delete for formal spot_id, local observation time and notes with explicit unsaved, error and conflict feedback.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-settings-child-route kind=requirement -->
The header gear and one display row open the same standalone Settings child route; Settings owns default place/location preference, experience level, max drive time, required facilities, equipment/capture preference, Day/Night choice, the sole observation-mode entry, subscription, privacy, cache, logout and deletion entry.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-observation-restore kind=requirement -->
Entering observation mode from Settings captures the exact prior Day/Night mode, route, formal spot, selectedAt, committed Finder state, pending draft and logical focus; exit restores that context without introducing a local Spot Night mode store or a bright transition.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-my-route-restoration kind=requirement -->
Explicit Back, system Back and keyboard/accessibility Back from Plan or Settings share one child-route owner and restore the My root scroll position plus the exact logical opener without remounting unrelated state.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-preference-boundary kind=requirement -->
User preferences influence ranking and explanation but do not rewrite provider facts, astronomical truth or independent safety hard blockers.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-library-states kind=requirement -->
My, Plan and Settings implement the applicable initial, loading, ready, empty, partial, stale, error and permission states while preserving recoverable drafts and usable account content.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=my-library-accessibility-layout kind=requirement -->
All My, Plan and Settings actions retain 44px hit regions, role/name/state, non-color selection cues, logical reading/focus order and 320/375/430 CSS-pixel plus large-text behavior without page-level horizontal scrolling.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-neutral-profile-links kind=requirement -->
External profile links store only user-declared platform, label, URL and visibility, make no affiliation claim, never scrape third-party profiles and retain Copy when Try Open is gated or fails.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-link-validation kind=requirement -->
Link save/open rejects dangerous schemes and unsupported destinations, preserves the draft on failure and records no secret, cookie or third-party account data.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-import-state-machine kind=requirement -->
Own-post import follows SOURCE → EDIT_DRAFT → ASSOCIATE_SPOT → PREVIEW → SUBMIT with explicit, recoverable state and independent parsing/moderation/spot-proposal statuses.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-rights-attestation kind=requirement -->
SOURCE records platform, original link, rights confirmation and import time; submission is blocked until the user attests they own or may republish the content.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-manual-import kind=requirement -->
Manual copy/import remains available regardless of automatic parser capability, platform permission, provider health or commercial license.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-parser-gates kind=requirement -->
Automatic parsing is enabled only for an allowlisted, licensed platform and applies URL allowlist, DNS/IP recheck, redirect, byte, MIME, timeout and SSRF controls.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-draft-protection kind=requirement -->
Parser retry/failure fills only unedited fields, never overwrites user edits, and uses field versions or optimistic locking with visible conflict recovery.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-spot-association kind=requirement -->
Import associates either an existing formal spot_id or an independent spot_proposal_id; proposal submission never creates a formal spot before separate review.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-lineage-moderation kind=requirement -->
Preview/submission preserves original-source lineage, visibility and moderation state and never presents imported content as official third-party platform content.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=profile-content-media-sanitization kind=requirement -->
Imported/uploaded media enforces count/type/size/use/expiry, private original storage, controlled display URLs, EXIF GPS removal, scan/quarantine and cleanup before public use.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-native-taro-project kind=requirement -->
Delivery is an actual Taro WeChat Mini Program project that builds to WeChat Mini Program artifacts and runs from project.config.json in WeChat DevTools; HTML resources remain reference constraints only.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-modular-monolith kind=requirement -->
Demo uses a modular monolith and stable domain/Port/Adapter boundaries; commercial scale may add capacity, reliability and governance without replacing business identities or page contracts.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-server-adapter-boundary kind=requirement -->
The Mini Program never calls weather, astronomy, light-pollution or route business providers directly; server-side adapters, cache, normalization, quota/cost and failure policy own every provider call.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-stable-identities kind=requirement -->
spot_id and internal domain IDs are canonical; provider IDs remain adapter mappings and business code contains no provider-specific branching.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-typed-api kind=requirement -->
Versioned /v1 page-level BFF APIs, generated typed SDK, ETag/conditional reads, local-date parameters, idempotency keys and explicit error variants own the client/server contract.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-data-state kind=requirement -->
Every response carries dataState and generatedAt/source summary using FRESH, STALE_USABLE, PARTIAL, EXPIRED, UNAVAILABLE, ESTIMATED or SAMPLE_DATA; missing facts are never coerced to zero.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-coordinates-timezone kind=requirement -->
WGS84 is canonical for astronomy/storage, GCJ-02 is explicit for mainland map presentation, branded point types cross boundaries, database time is UTC, spots store IANA timezone and observation nights may cross midnight.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-persistent-model kind=requirement -->
Persistent stores separate spots/facilities/media/content/favorites/plans/imports/drafts/proposals/dynamic snapshots/outbox/audit, and content moderation cannot overwrite spot-proposal review state.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-cache-revalidation kind=requirement -->
Client, Redis and precomputed read models use bounded TTL and stale-while-revalidate; static and dynamic degradation are independent and hard-expired data cannot produce Recommend.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-decision-engine kind=requirement -->
The deterministic decision engine applies hard blockers before sky/darkness/site/target/access scoring, emits recommendation/window/reasons/confidence and persists algorithm/input/source versions.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-ai-boundary kind=requirement -->
Generative AI may explain structured facts or draft advice, but cannot create weather, celestial, route or safety facts, override hard blockers or invent certainty when data is insufficient.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-feature-flags kind=requirement -->
Exactly TRIAL_REGION, ENABLED_PROVIDERS, UGC_MODE, LIGHT_LAYER_MODE, SKY_CATALOG_LEVEL, NOTIFICATION_ENABLED and COMMERCIAL_LICENSE_MODE gate Demo/commercial capabilities with safe defaults and auditable failure behavior.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-cost-envelope kind=requirement -->
Demo normal external-service cost target is CNY 0–100/month and the enforced projected monthly maximum is CNY 300; provider daily/monthly budgets degrade optional layers first and never remove map, weather summary, Spot Detail or navigation core.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-request-budget kind=requirement -->
Main package contains Map/My plus base components, first screen performs at most one aggregate business request excluding map tiles, markers are lightweight, media is thumbnail-first, large catalog/layers/media load on demand, exits cancel work and analytics batch/sample.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-provider-resilience kind=requirement -->
Adapters normalize units/time/coordinates/enums/nulls, map errors, record source/acquisition/validity, enforce timeout/concurrency/retry/backoff/circuit/budget/cache/fallback, and expose stable degraded semantics.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-media-upload-security kind=requirement -->
Uploads use bounded sessions and direct object storage, private originals, controlled variants, EXIF location stripping, content safety and cleanup; provider secrets exist only in server secret management.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-privacy-permissions kind=requirement -->
Location, external URL, notification and media permissions are least-privilege and purpose-specific; denial has manual fallback, continuous tracking is off by default, and privacy/deletion controls are reachable.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-outbox-jobs kind=requirement -->
Weather/astronomy/decision/light/media/freshness/provider-health/cost/notification/backup jobs use transactional Outbox, idempotent consumption, retry/dead-letter/observability and explicit completion.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-observability kind=requirement -->
Provider calls, cache quality, freshness, decision versions, errors, latency, cost, job completion and audit events are attributable without secrets or precise private location leakage.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=platform-operations-release-verification kind=requirement -->
Every release checks context, types, unit/contract/golden/security tests, package/build, cold start, map interaction, memory, responsive/accessibility/motion, failure recovery and current WeChat DevTools runtime on one candidate.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-full-feature-scope kind=requirement -->
The runnable Demo completes the map-first home, sole Finder with exact 18-filter semantics, map-coupled observing Conditions, formal Spot Detail and Spot Night, conventional My account center with standalone Plan/Settings, external profile links, own-post import, SourceLift, shared Notification, display modes, responsive behavior, motion, accessibility and explicit state/error recovery.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-primary-navigation kind=requirement -->
Primary navigation is exactly Map and My; Night Sky remains spot-scoped and all deep links activate their owning root without creating a third global destination.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-design-authority kind=requirement -->
Production consumes DESIGN.md target.system.wechat-miniapp-soft-instruments-2026-08-05 at #wechat-mini-program--soft-instruments-v1 as the sole exact visual-token authority and preserves Open Design user:soft-instruments lineage.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-design-resource-source-closure kind=requirement -->
The selected target is a complete immutable implementation-constraint Source for the final U1-U33 Mini Program design. Exact visual values remain owned by DESIGN.md; this handoff claims acquired-source closure and integrity rather than pixel-exact production fidelity.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-reference-not-proof kind=requirement -->
Formal handoff preflight and historical Open Design QA prove input identity/completeness only; current production layout, interaction, accessibility, responsive, motion and runtime behavior are independently re-proved.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-responsive kind=requirement -->
All material surfaces work at 320/375/430 CSS px, 750rpx semantics, safe areas and large text without page-level horizontal scrolling; only explicitly owned bounded rows/matrices may scroll.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-accessibility kind=requirement -->
Every action has at least an 88rpx/44px target, programmatic name/role/state, non-color selection/risk cues, logical focus/reading order and an accessible list/control alternative for native map/canvas content.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-modes kind=requirement -->
Day, night and observation modes preserve route, selection, focus order and information hierarchy; observation is black/warm-red, media opt-in and free of unowned bright transitions.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-motion kind=requirement -->
Press, sheet, route, marker/card, scrubber and mode motion follow the selected target, remain interruptible, and provide a reduced-motion equivalent without losing state feedback.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-shared-source-lift kind=requirement -->
Finder panelOnly and observing-conditions mapCoupled projection use one SourceLiftFocusLayer state machine and one live-node transfer protocol; the two focus surfaces are mutually exclusive and restore exact geometry, scroll, focus, map and ownership state.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-shared-notification kind=requirement -->
One Notification owner arbitrates inline and floating feedback using error before warning before info before success, deduplicates repeated events, preserves the affected owner and exposes a stable accessible recovery action without covering primary controls.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-global-scrollbar kind=requirement -->
Vertical owner scrolling remains functional while visual scrollbar chrome is hidden throughout the selected product; horizontal scrolling exists only for explicitly declared bounded matrices and never for a page, Finder list, Filter or My root.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-selected-card-star kind=requirement -->
Selected cards and filter choices reuse one half-cut rounded rainbow-star decorator plus border, glyph or checked state so selection is never color-only and no second decorative token or icon truth is introduced.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-shared-states kind=requirement -->
INITIAL, LOADING, READY, EMPTY, PARTIAL, STALE, ERROR and PERMISSION_DENIED are explicit, preserve usable content and context, disclose cause/freshness, and provide stable retry/manual recovery.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-facts-and-licenses kind=requirement -->
All external platform, astronomical, map, spot and media facts carry capability gate, source, license, freshness, confidence and failure semantics; design examples and SAMPLE_DATA are never presented as runtime facts.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-commercial-boundary kind=requirement -->
Commercial enhancements not activated in this delivery retain explicit interfaces, feature gates and evolution paths without adding unrequested production services, nationwide claims, open UGC or billing.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-cold-start-journeys kind=requirement -->
Fresh production cold starts cover Map → Finder/filter → formal callout → Detail → Spot Night, Map → observing Conditions preview/commit, My → Plan, My → Settings → observation-mode enter/exit/restore, and Profile links/import through submission preview with degradation/recovery branches.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-machine-acceptance kind=requirement -->
Only the current final snapshot may be accepted, after every declared Check is rerun with typed evidence; historical results, delegated reports, prose inspection or handoff preflight cannot satisfy production Claims.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=complete-demo-terminal-state kind=requirement -->
Completion requires fresh machine_accepted, no pending External Confirmation, Goal semantic-veto equality, Context drift closure and formal Long-Task close; any weaker state is reported as qualified or blocked.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=architecture-deliberation kind=technical_obligation aspect=architecture -->
Architecture Deliberation: apps/wechat-miniapp/** owns the independently completable Mini Program and its route/component/state lifecycles; packages/miniapp-contracts/** owns typed domain and BFF contracts; workers/miniapp-api/** owns server adapters, normalization, cache and failure policy; tools/miniapp/** and tests/acceptance/miniapp/** own attributable current-candidate verification. The current extension points and sources of truth are the existing Taro route shell, app-store committed state, one FilterSchema, stable spot_id/selectedAt/favorite/plan/import identities, typed Port/Adapter boundary, DESIGN.md exact visual tokens, the complete frozen 16-resource selected-v3 closure and the project verifier/carrier protocol. Dependencies remain UI → store/contracts/domain ports → server adapters. Finder and Conditions extend one shared SourceLiftFocusLayer lifecycle and one shared Notification owner; request, permission, draft/commit, cancellation, focus, route/background restoration, cache, persistence, failure and recovery boundaries remain explicit. The selected design retains the Taro native Mini Program and modular-monolith backend. Build/Reuse/Buy admits every materially supported choice: reuse approved project primitives/icons and existing state/route owners, adopt a mature compatible lightweight dependency when it does not add a second design/state truth, implement a bounded project-owned primitive when SourceLift or Notification semantics are project-specific, or intentionally avoid abstraction for one isolated responsibility. This delivery selects reuse of existing Taro/React primitives and app-store owners plus bounded shared SourceLift/Notification owners; a heavy second UI system, token/icon catalogue, second map/store or duplicate owner-held rule is prohibited. The single physical native map persists under panelOnly Finder and mapCoupled Conditions. One live focus node transfers through IDLE, LIFTING, FOCUSED, RESTORING and CANCELLED, retains exact origin geometry/scroll/focus/map state and returns ownership atomically; rapid retargeting begins from the live presentation value. Spot Detail owns Overview/Guides/Site and a formal spot-scoped Night child. My owns a conventional root plus standalone Plan and Settings children; Settings alone owns observation entry and exact prior-context restoration. The project-owned native verifier, frozen launcher, physical snapshot identity, byte-exact delivery carrier, counterfactual projection and cleanup lifecycle remain the verification extension point. Selected resource preflight proves only frozen input integrity; native map/canvas/sensor, production layout/pixel/accessibility/motion/interaction, real provider facts, real coordinate authorization and real WeChat identity require independent downstream observation and cannot be machine-closed by static shape or browser proxy. Rejected alternatives are HTML/WebView delivery, rebuilding from the canonical HTML, sampled or truncated authority, current-screen-led semantics, a global Night route, My peer tabs/Favorites duplication, cloned/remounted SourceLift content, direct provider calls, provider IDs as domain ownership, duplicated filters/time/mode/favorite/design truth, premature microservices, manual carrier hash repair, disabling snapshot validation, or treating input preflight/historical/delegated evidence as current production proof. A future nationwide, multi-provider or approved-UGC change must extend adapters, feature gates and read models without changing spot_id, route or product-surface ownership. A future Finder filter or focus mode must extend the one FilterSchema/SourceLift owner. A future selected design creates a new immutable resource version and updates the owning Screen Contract adoption record without overwriting this baseline. Touched debt is the stale old Map filter/detail projection and My peer-tab/Favorites implementation plus the absence of shared SourceLift/Notification; it is removed in the owning Mini Program modules, while unrelated React Native debt stays out of scope. New or worsened duplicate truth, wrong dependency direction, owner bypass, silent failure, resource-lifecycle defect, scope escape, fake closure of partial/excluded requirements and unsupported quality claims block handoff. Correctness/invariants and maintainability/changeability are mandatory; reliability/resource lifecycle, concurrency/consistency, performance/capacity/cost, security/privacy/safety, compatibility/migration/rollout and operability/observability/testability are all material and receive project-owned current-candidate checks or explicit blocking External Confirmation.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-closure kind=requirement -->
The complete 50-Control inventory and all declared cross-Control relations are closed: no material production action, state, navigation, feedback or accessibility responsibility may be hidden outside these owners.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-primary-vs-my-children kind=requirement -->
Primary navigation owns only Map/My while Plan and Settings are standalone child routes reached from the conventional My account center; no peer My tabs or Favorites branch exist. Related Controls: mini-primary-navigation, my-grouped-entry-list, my-plan-entry, my-settings-action.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-finder-draft-commit kind=requirement -->
Filter disclosure, the exact 18-filter editor and Finder results share one schema; dismissal/revert restores the snapshot and commit atomically updates the single query-plus-filter projection. Related Controls: map-finder-filter-disclosure, map-finder-filter-overlay, map-finder-result-list.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-finder-exclusive-overlays kind=requirement -->
Query suggestions/history and Filter are mutually exclusive overlays anchored to the one Finder field without moving result or owner-scroll geometry. Related Controls: map-finder-search-field, map-finder-query-overlay, map-finder-filter-overlay.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-map-selection kind=requirement -->
Finder result, formal marker and compact callout expose one selected spot; only a valid callout release, keyboard or accessibility activation enters canonical Detail. Related Controls: map-finder-result-list, map-marker-card-coordinator, map-selected-spot-callout.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-source-lift-mutual-exclusion kind=requirement -->
One SourceLiftFocusLayer serializes panelOnly Finder and mapCoupled Conditions; only one can own the live focus node and Back/Escape/scrim behavior at a time. Related Controls: source-lift-focus-layer, map-spot-finder-trigger, map-spot-finder-sheet, map-analysis-time-bar, map-analysis-focus-layer.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-source-lift-restoration kind=requirement -->
Both focus modes retain one live node, one origin placeholder and one state owner, restore from live geometry and atomically return exact scroll, focus, map and interaction ownership without clone/remount/jump/flash. Related Controls: source-lift-focus-layer, map-spot-finder-sheet, map-analysis-focus-layer.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-detail-child-context kind=requirement -->
Overview/Guides/Site retain spot_id and load independently; the upper Night action is a child route carrying the complete formal spot/time/revision context, never a fourth segment. Related Controls: spot-segment-tabs, spot-tonight-decision, spot-night-entry, spot-facility-evidence.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-favorite-consistency kind=requirement -->
Spot Detail favorite and Finder Wanted own one relation; optimistic failure rolls back visibly and dynamic-summary failure never deletes or hides the underlying relation. Related Controls: spot-favorite-action, map-finder-result-list.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-sky-context kind=requirement -->
Sky consumers share one versioned spot/time context and sensor orientation changes presentation only. Related Controls: sky-time-scrubber, sky-map-canvas, sky-professional-matrix, sky-target-list.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-mode-context kind=requirement -->
Settings is the sole observation entry; display and observation modes preserve route/focus/selection/drafts and observation exit restores the exact previous Day/Night mode and pending context. Related Controls: display-mode-switcher, settings-form, observation-mode-control.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-notification-arbitration kind=requirement -->
One shared Notification owner deduplicates events, applies error > warning > info > success and never hides usable content, source/freshness disclosure or the stable owning recovery action. Related Controls: notification-feedback, page-state-recovery, data-source-disclosure.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-my-route-restoration kind=requirement -->
Explicit, system and keyboard/accessibility Back share one child-route lifecycle and restore My root scroll plus the exact logical opener. Related Controls: my-settings-action, my-plan-entry, plan-editor, settings-form.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-link-fallback kind=requirement -->
External-link validation preserves drafts and Copy remains available whenever Try Open is denied, gated or fails. Related Controls: profile-link-editor, profile-link-open-copy.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-import-protection kind=requirement -->
Import preserves edited fields, rights and lineage while formal spot_id and proposal_id remain disjoint through review. Related Controls: import-source-rights, import-draft-editor, import-spot-association, import-preview-submit.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

<!-- ty-source-item:start key=control-relation-state-recovery kind=requirement -->
Shared state recovery never substitutes fake facts, hides usable static content or omits source, freshness, failure and recovery disclosure. Related Controls: page-state-recovery, notification-feedback, data-source-disclosure.
<!-- ty-source-item:end -->

        - fact.complete-demo.architecture.deliberation
        - cell.complete-demo.architecture.deliberation

        - structure_ref: structure.04ed33f3335cc6458236cc2a
          arguments:
            - input.source.architecture.deliberation
            - architecture-deliberation
            - d11f02c377a7aa995fe617f31d61b9d8a987ea2755f08451c07afb77cd9cf1ca
            - "Architecture Deliberation: apps/wechat-miniapp/** owns the independently completable Mini Program and its route/component/state lifecycles; packages/miniapp-contracts/** owns typed domain and BFF contracts; workers/miniapp-api/** owns server adapters, normalization, cache and failure policy; tools/miniapp/** and tests/acceptance/miniapp/** own attributable current-candidate verification. The current extension points and sources of truth are the existing Taro route shell, app-store committed state, one FilterSchema, stable spot_id/selectedAt/favorite/plan/import identities, typed Port/Adapter boundary, DESIGN.md exact visual tokens, the complete frozen 16-resource selected-v3 closure and the project verifier/carrier protocol. Dependencies remain UI → store/contracts/domain ports → server adapters. Finder and Conditions extend one shared SourceLiftFocusLayer lifecycle and one shared Notification owner; request, permission, draft/commit, cancellation, focus, route/background restoration, cache, persistence, failure and recovery boundaries remain explicit. The selected design retains the Taro native Mini Program and modular-monolith backend. Build/Reuse/Buy admits every materially supported choice: reuse approved project primitives/icons and existing state/route owners, adopt a mature compatible lightweight dependency when it does not add a second design/state truth, implement a bounded project-owned primitive when SourceLift or Notification semantics are project-specific, or intentionally avoid abstraction for one isolated responsibility. This delivery selects reuse of existing Taro/React primitives and app-store owners plus bounded shared SourceLift/Notification owners; a heavy second UI system, token/icon catalogue, second map/store or duplicate owner-held rule is prohibited. The single physical native map persists under panelOnly Finder and mapCoupled Conditions. One live focus node transfers through IDLE, LIFTING, FOCUSED, RESTORING and CANCELLED, retains exact origin geometry/scroll/focus/map state and returns ownership atomically; rapid retargeting begins from the live presentation value. Spot Detail owns Overview/Guides/Site and a formal spot-scoped Night child. My owns a conventional root plus standalone Plan and Settings children; Settings alone owns observation entry and exact prior-context restoration. The project-owned native verifier, frozen launcher, physical snapshot identity, byte-exact delivery carrier, counterfactual projection and cleanup lifecycle remain the verification extension point. Selected resource preflight proves only frozen input integrity; native map/canvas/sensor, production layout/pixel/accessibility/motion/interaction, real provider facts, real coordinate authorization and real WeChat identity require independent downstream observation and cannot be machine-closed by static shape or browser proxy. Rejected alternatives are HTML/WebView delivery, rebuilding from the canonical HTML, sampled or truncated authority, current-screen-led semantics, a global Night route, My peer tabs/Favorites duplication, cloned/remounted SourceLift content, direct provider calls, provider IDs as domain ownership, duplicated filters/time/mode/favorite/design truth, premature microservices, manual carrier hash repair, disabling snapshot validation, or treating input preflight/historical/delegated evidence as current production proof. A future nationwide, multi-provider or approved-UGC change must extend adapters, feature gates and read models without changing spot_id, route or product-surface ownership. A future Finder filter or focus mode must extend the one FilterSchema/SourceLift owner. A future selected design creates a new immutable resource version and updates the owning Screen Contract adoption record without overwriting this baseline. Touched debt is the stale old Map filter/detail projection and My peer-tab/Favorites implementation plus the absence of shared SourceLift/Notification; it is removed in the owning Mini Program modules, while unrelated React Native debt stays out of scope. New or worsened duplicate truth, wrong dependency direction, owner bypass, silent failure, resource-lifecycle defect, scope escape, fake closure of partial/excluded requirements and unsupported quality claims block handoff. Correctness/invariants and maintainability/changeability are mandatory; reliability/resource lifecycle, concurrency/consistency, performance/capacity/cost, security/privacy/safety, compatibility/migration/rollout and operability/observability/testability are all material and receive project-owned current-candidate checks or explicit blocking External Confirmation."
